key_insight: Medi-Gemma combines deterministic EMR analytics with retrieval-augmented generation to reduce hallucinations and keep clinical answers grounded in validated patient data.
clinical_relevance: This hybrid CDSS is designed to support wound pathology triage and workflow automation while enforcing traceable, evidence-based reasoning.
method: ClinicalOrchestrator coordinates the pipeline and separates perception from data orchestration.
DataManager cleans EMR files and routes structured queries to PandasQueryEngine; clinical questions go to ClinicalRAGEngine with a CPU-optimized vector store.
Ground Truth Injection and SafetyVerifier inject validated patient snapshots and block rule-violating outputs.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that validation showed improved factual adherence to backend clinical repositories, eliminated semantic context drift, and prevented database compilation crashes.
watch_item: Performance and safety will still depend on high-quality structured EMR data, correct query routing, and careful clinical deployment/monitoring.
paper_title: Medi-Gemma: A Hybrid Clinical Decision Support System Integrating Deterministic EMR Analytics and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
